subject: history

items.q: Did the USA and USSR fight each other directly in the Cold War?
items.correct: No — it was tension, an arms race and proxy wars, not direct war between them.
items.misconception: Yes, their armies fought each other openly.
items.random_wrong: They signed a peace treaty in 1945.
items.why: Direct conflict was avoided (mutual nuclear deterrence); they clashed through proxies like Korea and Vietnam.

items.q: Who built the Berlin Wall in 1961, and why?
items.correct: East Germany/the USSR, to stop people fleeing to the West.
items.misconception: The Western Allies, to keep people out.
items.random_wrong: The United Nations, as a peace barrier.
items.why: The Wall stemmed the flow of East Germans escaping to West Berlin.

items.q: How did the Cuban Missile Crisis (1962) end?
items.correct: Diplomatically — the USSR removed its missiles; the USA secretly removed missiles from Turkey.
items.random_wrong: With a US invasion of the USSR.
items.why: Kennedy and Khrushchev reached a deal, pulling back from the brink.
